sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Seventh Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(SEVENTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 12th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(18)/70-IX/6723,
dated 12-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Seventh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
